August 19, 1992

One Park Avenue, New York, N.Y. 10016-5895 • (212) 545-3000

Lorillard
TOBACCO COMPANY

TO: J. Platt

FROM: J. J. Tatulli

SUBJECT: PRODUCT INFORMATION -- HARLEY DAVIDSON

Please remove the existing 11 cs KS and 19 cs Lts. KS Harley Davidson Product from the Portland Distributing Warehouse for destruction in Greensboro.

The FSO has advised they have pulled through as much as possible and would need another 2-3 months to complete. Based on our conversation I feel that this old product would do us more harm than good with the consumer and should be removed. Dick Safely concurs.

[SIGNATURE] J. J. T.

Thank you.

/jr

cc: A. Giacoio
D. Safely
T. Blachly
M. Caso
G. Brooks
